row:
Duke Animal Hospital is a privately owned general practice veterinary clinic in the Lakeview neighborhood of Chicago, IL. With humble beginnings in 2011 as a mobile veterinary clinic, it has since expanded to it's large brick-and-mortar location with a staff of over 50 employees. 

We're here to serve our community Monday - Saturday from 7 am to 7 pm for routine and urgent visits.
